up: Return all activity records from assay CHEMBL1614481, with exact activity values (relation and value), units, and activity type. For each activity record, provide the molecule's ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES. If a molecule lacks a defined structure (canonical SMILES), still include the record with a NULL SMILES value.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_type, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614481'
